/about/.html:
About

Progressive Autosports was started in 1996 with one vision to personalize automobiles using only the finest quality products.  The idea was to individualize each vehicle with one concept treat each vehicle as it was our own…We use the finest products, most innovative ideas, and the best people using the most high tech equipment, for each vehicle we customize. So our clients can be reassured their vehicle is in the best hands. We work on the finest automobiles, such as Mercedes, Bmw, Ferrari, Lamborghini. Etc…Using the best brands in the industry such as Vellano, Brabus, Wald, Tsw, Vredestein, Eclipse, Alpine. Etc etc.

Progressive Autosports only carries original brands no inferior copies. All our products are first line,  no blemished products.  Our three piece wheels are hand produced with the highest quality standards in the industry, using the best aluminum forging, assembly hardware, and the most innovative designs with safety in mind… We pay attention to  detail and focus on one vehicle at a time, We don’t go after quantity but quality,  which our clients have become accustomed to.

Motor Sales

At Progressive Motorsports you will find we are not your average used car dealership that sells average used cars. We specialize in distinguished automobiles luxury cars that have their own personality. We are a Houston TX based used car dealership that values relationships and realizes our customers’ wants and expectations. We only deliver luxury cars customized using the best products together with the best people in the automotive industry. With our 15+ years of experience in the automotive customized business you can be assured whether it’s a car with just custom wheels or a fully customized one of a kind car with aero kit wheels paint interior etc. We are not just sales people we are enthusiasts ourselves and realize that for our clients it’s not just about their car it’s their dream. We have an onsite high tech paint shop using all waterborne paint system a wheel and tire facility offering you the widest selection of custom wheels and tires and a personalized auto detail facility paying meticulous attention to vehicle detailing. Feel free to contact us regarding your next vehicle purchase submit a service request apply for car financing or have us locate your dream vehicle . Also keep us in mind if you would like us to sell your prized possession.

History

History

What started off as a Dream…has turned into Reality…

Progressive AutoSports was started in 1996 with one vision to personalize automobiles using only the finest quality products. The idea was to individualize each vehicle with one concept… treat each vehicle as it was our own…We use the finest products, most innovative ideas, and the best people using the most high tech equipment, for each vehicle we customize. So our clients can be reassured their vehicle is in the best hands. We work on the finest automobiles, such as Mercedes, Bmw, Ferrari, Lamborghini. Etc…Using the best brands in the industry such as Vellano, Taza designs, Brabus, Wald, Tsw, Vredestein, Eclipse, Alpine. Etc etc

Progressive autosports only carries original brands no inferior copies. All our products are first line, no blemished products. Our three piece wheels are hand produced with the highest quality standards in the industry, using the best aluminum forging, assembly hardware, and the most innovative designs with safety in mind…We pay attention to detail and focus on one vehicle at a time, We don’t go after quantity but quality, which our clients have become accustomed to. We are car enthusiasts ourselves, So we know its not only your vehicle you are trusting us with, Its your dream…

Visit our local showroom when you are in Houston, and you will be impressed with our facility. We are often imitated but never duplicated, and at progressive autosports IMAGE IS EVERYTHING.

Specialties:purchasing, development, branding and marketing
